row.team_price_text: Pro: $37/mo billed annually (introductory $444 first year; renews at $870/yr), flat per account
row.evidence: OptinMonster's docs describe inviting sub-account users manually from Account > Sub-Accounts (Pro and higher) and Okta SSO only for Growth and Enterprise with a one-time implementation fee; no SCIM endpoint or user API is documented.
row.notes: New row. Flat per-account pricing (sites and impressions), not per user, so per-user fields are null; prices are first-year introductory annual prices and renew higher (Pro $870/yr, Growth $1,470/yr). Pro is team_plan as the first tier with sub-accounts (2); Growth has unlimited. Okta SAML SSO is Growth/Enterprise with a one-time implementation fee and is set up by OptinMonster support. Okta's OIN app is SWA only. No SCIM, no documented user-management API: none by absence after searching the pricing page, the full docs sitemap (302 docs), the API key doc and the Okta/Entra catalogues.

plans.name: Basic
plans.price_text: $9/month billed annually ($108 first year, introductory); renews at $210/yr
plans.notes: Flat per-account price (1 site, 2,500 impressions); no sub-accounts.

plans.name: Plus
plans.price_text: $27/month billed annually ($324 first year, introductory); renews at $570/yr

plans.name: Pro
plans.price_text: $37/month billed annually ($444 first year, introductory); renews at $870/yr

plans.name: Growth
plans.price_text: $67/month billed annually ($804 first year, introductory); renews at $1,470/yr
plans.notes: Unlimited sub-accounts; Okta SAML SSO available with a one-time implementation fee (contact support). Activity Log is in-app only.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented. Sub-account users are invited manually in Account > Sub-Accounts; SSO is a support-configured Okta SAML app.

audit_log_api.notes: In-app Activity Log on Growth (c14); no API documented.

limitations.text: OptinMonster API keys (My Account > API) exist to connect OptinMonster with other platforms; no public API reference documents user or sub-account management.

okta.notes: OIN listing (last updated Oct 2016) ticks only SWA in page markup; SAML, SCIM and provisioning are unticked. OptinMonster's own Okta SSO guide uses a custom internal SAML app (c8).

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial found (learn.microsoft.com saas-apps/optinmonster-tutorial 404).

fallbacks.notes: SSO guide says users with the configured email domain are redirected to SSO login; it does not say accounts are created on first sign-in.
